verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of bulk user import, importing password hashes, or exporting users with their hashes. It only mentions generic user-management SDKs and APIs, triggers linking auth data to your own tables, self-hosting, and a community comment that copying user data to a public table is trivial. These are building blocks or user-side workarounds, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bulk-import existing users — including password hashes — and export them again, so I am never locked in
